title: CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder (12 layers, 768 wide), FLUX.1's short text encoder

provenance.source: safetensors header of diffusion_models/flux1-schnell-fp8.safetensors (17236328572 bytes) on the reference target (ComfyUI Desktop 0.44.0 on port 8188, GAPS Q17), its text_encoders.clip_l.transformer tensors
provenance.note: No stand-alone CLIP-L file is installed on the reference target, so the names are the embedded encoder's with the text_encoders.clip_l.transformer. prefix removed: token_embedding [49408, 768], position_embedding [77, 768], encoder layers 0 to 11. CLIP-G is 1280 wide with 32 layers and doesn't match. Not yet checked against a stand-alone clip_l.safetensors header; a file whose names differ matches no rule and stays unknown.
